title: 共识在战略上不足：推理轨迹分歧作为知识表示信号
summary: 本文提出多智能体系统中，对于价值负载任务，分歧可能反映规范不确定性而非错误。通过将推理轨迹和决策抽象为符号分歧状态（收敛一致、发散一致、收敛分歧、发散分歧），支持可废止的战略路由规则，在内容审核中实例化，连接亚符号LLM审议与符号知识表示。
summary_en: This paper argues that in multi-agent systems for value-laden tasks, disagreement may reflect normative uncertainty rather than error. It proposes a knowledge-representation layer abstracting reasoning traces and decisions into symbolic disagreement states (convergent agreement, divergent agreement, convergent disagreement, divergent disagreement), supporting defeasible strategic routing, instantiated in content moderation to bridge sub-symbolic LLM deliberation and symbolic knowledge representation.
